Then 1-p*=[(u_d-1)^(-2)-d^-2]/eta_d~d^-2/3, while 1-p_L~4/d, so for sufficiently large d, p*<p_L and the explicit affine entanglement-of-formation branch applies. Fang's Proposition 12 affine cubic-norm branch yields B_d(c*)=log_2 d-s_d eta_d p*, s_d=3log_2 u_d, hence exact witness difference p*(s_d eta_d-kappa_d), kappa_d=(d²-1)/(d(d-2)) log_2(d-1). Elementary rewriting gives 3eta_d log_2(1+x^(-2/3))-2x(x+2)log_2 x/[(x+1)^2(x-1)]; the first term is 3 x^(-2/3)/ln2+o(x^-2/3), second O(log x/x)=o(x^-2/3). Thus liminf d^(2/3)G_d>=3/ln2, matching Fang's independently inspected Corollary 13 limsup. Independent numerical reconstruction verifies p* in affine region, positive witness below published bound, and convergence at d=10^3,...,10^8. No finite experiment is used to prove the limiting equality.
